name: The Residences at The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort
insider_take: Where the Dominican Republic's most exclusive address meets the legendary St. Regis standard of refinement — Cap Cana is not just a resort, it's a world unto itself.
whats_special: Nestled within the gated luxury enclave of Cap Cana — one of the Caribbean's largest and most prestigious private resort communities — The Residences at The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort offer an unmatched blend of residential comfort and five-star hotel service. Guests enjoy access to the iconic Punta Espada Golf Course, consistently ranked among the top courses in the Caribbean and Latin America, as well as a stunning marina, pristine private beaches, and the signature St. Regis Butler Service available around the clock. The resort's design draws inspiration from the colonial grandeur of the Dominican Republic, with dramatic architecture set against turquoise waters.
pro_tip: Request a Butler-curated sunset ritual on your private terrace — the St. Regis signature Bloody Mary service at golden hour over the Caribbean Sea is an experience you simply cannot replicate anywhere else.
dont_miss: A round at Punta Espada Golf Course , designed by Jack Nicklaus and featuring four oceanfront holes — regularly ranked the #1 golf course in the Caribbean. Also, explore the Cap Cana Marina , one of the largest marinas in the Caribbean, offering world-class deep-sea fishing in waters teeming with blue marlin.
pros: Signature St. Regis Butler Service provides personalized, around-the-clock attention for a truly bespoke luxury experience
Expansive private residences with high-end finishes, full kitchens, and spacious living areas ideal for extended stays or families
Privileged access to Cap Cana's pristine beaches, world-class marina, and championship golf courses
Exceptional dining and curated culinary experiences befitting the St. Regis legacy of refinement
Enrollment in the Marriott Bonvoy STARS program unlocks exclusive perks and elite benefits for qualifying guests
cons: Secluded gated community setting in Cap Cana may require a car or resort transport to explore beyond the property
Ultra-luxury residence pricing positions this property at the highest end of the Caribbean market
